question: India beat ____ in the final of the Asian Kabaddi Championship 2023 at the Dong-Eui Institute of Technology Seokdang Cultural center in Busan, Republic of Korea, in July 2023
solution:
The correct answer is__** Iran**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Asian Kabaddi Championship 2023 was held at the **Dong-Eui Institute of Technology Seokdang Cultural Center in Busan,** Republic of Korea, showcasing top teams from across Asia.
 
• **India emerged victorious against Iran**, successfully defending their title and continuing their dominance in the sport.
 
• The Indian team featured standout performances from key players, contributing significantly to their win through effective strategies and teamwork.
 
• This victory reaffirmed India’s status as a powerhouse in kabaddi, adding to its rich legacy in the sport and highlighting its popularity across Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Kabaddi Championship:**

 
 
• The Asian Kabaddi Championship is a prestigious tournament that promotes the sport of kabaddi among Asian countries and features teams competing for the title.
 
• **Established in 2000,** the championship has been held periodically, with India being the most successful nation in its history.
 
• The tournament usually includes a round-robin stage followed by knockout rounds, featuring top kabaddi teams from countries like India, Iran, Pakistan, and Bangladesh.
 
• The championship enhances the popularity of kabaddi, providing a platform for emerging players and **fostering international competition and sportsmanship.**
